message: 香りづけにはごま油

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, Pasta-san. Let's give it our all again today!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Give me a break already, nya...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're looking awfully haggard, Pasta.」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm deeply regretting never having cooked before, nyan...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We just need to make up for lost time. After all, the word 'impossible' doesn't exist in this world.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you doing okay, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. Despite how I look, I'm surprisingly tough, you know.」
Indeed, she didn't seem the type to get a stomach ulcer from stress.

name: Sally
message: 「So, when's the good food coming out?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan!! Why are you here...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I invited her over for a meal.」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss is the real gourmet, sure, but I'm no slouch either!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you planning something so extravagant it'll impress Sally-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today, I'm thinking of trying my hand at a beefsteak lunch.」

name: Synn
message: 「Beefsteak!? Did Prier even have that on the menu!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez's eyes were probably all blurry, so he couldn't see it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Tears are welling up... But is this where we are now after overcoming that hardship?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, in for a penny, in for a cucumber! Let's get fired up and go!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Save me, Lord Virus, nya...」

name: Sally
message: 「Have a good time!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, where's Pasta?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He inhaled a bit too much smoke, so he's resting.」

name: Sally
message: 「Pasta, huh! What a delicious-sounding name!」

name: Synn
message: 「She used to be a girl you couldn't handle no matter how you cooked her, though. She's really trying her best」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, were you planning on eating Pasta-san!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is that supposed to mean!」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez. Wanna e-a-t me? Ufufu~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm good」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't answer immediately!!」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, beefsteak! Beefsteak!」

name: Sally
message: 「Beefsteak♪ Beefsteak♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah... well, about that... ehehe~\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「What's with that shady laugh, what happened」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry. Actually, it ended up burned to a crisp\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah... what a waste...」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez! We went through all the trouble, so let's just eat it」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's full of carcinogens. Don't do it」

name: Synn
message: 「A plushie won't get cancer, right? Eat up, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't want it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. No wonder smoke was coming out」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So that's why Pasta-san got carbon monoxide poisoning」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't that bad?」

name: Sally
message: 「Listen. Lolo-chi, you're super terrible at cooking, aren't you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hic!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-th-th-that's not true! Aah, well, maybe it is, but--」

name: Synn
message: 「You're working hard because you want to make delicious food, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-Yes, that's right! Nice save, President-san\s07」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm~ Well, I guess angels don't really need to cook, do they」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「While in Heaven, we can survive without eating meals, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Hoho~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, you can't feel truly happy unless your stomach is full!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah. So happy you could just lie right down and turn into a cow」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what they call the beefsteak food chain, isn't it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「More importantly, I am NOT an angel!!」

name: Sally
message: 「At this rate, poor Ms. Moo-Moo won't be able to rest in peace」

name: Lolotte
message: 「May the rest of her cuts at least be called up to Heaven」

name: Sally
message: 「If it's come to this, well then. Leave it to me!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're going to cook, Omake-san?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep! As the assault captain of the Delicious Food Squad, I, Sally, am gonna whip up a dish that'll shut even a crying baby right up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see... Indeed, it is written that once a gourmet reaches the pinnacle, they recognize no taste other than their own」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine if you're getting lessons, Lolotte, but what about Pasta?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He's in worn-out mode right now, so let's have him be our taste tester」

name: Synn
message: 「Good luck~」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ginyaaa!!」
Before long, a scream echoed from the kitchen.

name: Sally
message: 「Tehe☆ Come to think of it, I actually like eating way more than cooking\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was a fool for ever expecting anything from you, Omake-san」

name: Sally
message: 「What was that?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, that's enough bickering from the two of you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It really is hopeless without Sensei around~」

name: Sally
message: 「Isn't there anyone left here who can do it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Looks like it's finally my time to shine.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hair'll get in the food, so no way!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You'll melt if you get close to the fire.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'd burn, you idiot!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, it seems we have no choice but to ask the President.」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you before, didn't I? You have to taste-test your food properly.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. That's why I made sure to do it thoroughly once it was finished.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not after it's done. You do it while you're making it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What!!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you do that, you can tell the exact moment the dish tastes best, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see! So that way it won't burn to the pan either.」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like you'd know that just by looking at it\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「Not bad, Prez. Just what I'd expect from the guy I set my sights on.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks. And what I whipped up like that is this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!! Steaming hot--」

name: Synn
message: 「Bean sprout stir-fry over rice」

name: Sally
message: 「It's so crunchy and delicious!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It really makes you want to keep eating the rice~~」

name: Pasta
message: 「Sigh... ly got my paws on a decent meal, nya...」

name: Paqy
message: 「This counts as decent...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Pasta? Working hard on customer service is way easier than cooking, isn't it?」

name: Pasta
message: 「That would be the wiser choice, nya...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, cooking is quite deep and fun, isn't it♪」

name: Sally
message: 「You're making delicious food, after all. Of course it's bound to be fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not all. Having everyone say 'Delicious!' like this is also pretty rewarding.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「It makes you want to make something delicious again next time, too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haaah~~. I'd love to make something someday that makes people say 'Delicious!' too~~」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyafun. That's bound to be impossible anyway, nya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why are you talking like it has nothing to do with you?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyanya?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's keep doing our best together from now on, okay?\s04」

name: Pasta
message: 「Give me a break already, nyaaa!!」
